description: This file is a C++ source file implementing the LEDControl plugin for the WPEFramework. It manages LED states such as supported states, current state retrieval, and state setting via JSON-RPC methods. It interacts with platform-specific functions like dsFPGetSupportedLEDStates, dsFPGetLEDState, and dsFPSetLEDState and defines plugin registration, initialization, and deinitialization routines.

classes.name: LEDControl
classes.description: A plugin class that provides JSON-RPC API for controlling and querying LED states on the platform.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the platform-specific LED subsystem if not already initialized.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the LED subsystem and cleans up resources.

methods.name: getSupportedLEDStates
methods.description: Retrieves the list of LED states supported by the platform.

methods.name: getLEDState
methods.description: Retrieves the current LED state of the platform.

methods.name: setLEDState
methods.description: Sets the LED to a specified state.
